annotation.interpretation_a: The entire first client packet, including all headers and data, must not exceed 1232 octets.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only the payload portion of the first client packet (excluding QUIC headers) must not exceed 1232 octets.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'fit within' is ambiguous. It could refer to the entire packet or just the payload. Without clarification, implementers could reasonably interpret the requirement differently, leading to interoperability issues.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the 1232 octet limit applies to the entire packet or just the payload. This affects how much data can be included in the first client packet.
